question: What supported recovery contract should apply when `socket.drain` cannot be queued for a slow Gateway client?
rationale: Source inspection establishes that the current implementation closes the connection without delivering the event, but only Gateway ownership can choose whether the durable contract is disconnect-and-resync, best-effort reconciliation, or bounded priority delivery.

options.title: Disconnect and resync
options.body: Close overloaded clients with an explicit recoverable reason and require reconnect plus authoritative session-state resynchronization.

options.title: Drop and reconcile
options.body: Use ordinary frame shedding and document periodic authoritative session reconciliation as required downstream behavior.

options.title: Bounded priority delivery
options.body: Introduce a separately bounded lifecycle-event path with a defined overflow fallback and no unbounded buffering.

recommendation.title: Disconnect and resync
recommendation.body: Close overloaded clients with an explicit recoverable reason and require reconnect plus authoritative session-state resynchronization.

likelyOwner.reason: His recent merged work owns the shared session-change projection most directly extended by this PR, with adjacent broadcaster ownership shared across other Gateway contributors.
